load_openimages_data_list: load Open Images dataset annotations from CSV file into a list of data dictionaries with bounding boxes
parse_openimages_label_file: parse the Open Images label description CSV file to get class names and label ID mapping
parse_openimages_img_level_ann: parse image level annotations CSV file to get labels and confidences per image
get_openimages_relation_matrix: get the class hierarchy relation matrix from a JSON hierarchy file for parent-child class relationships
load_openimages_challenge_data: load Open Images Challenge dataset annotations from a TXT file with image paths and instance bounding boxes
